title.narrative: Cooperation in International Waters in Africa (CIWA) Multi Donor Trust Fund

description.narrative:
"THE DEVELOPMENT OBJECTIVE OF THE PROPOSED CIWA-MDTF IS TO STRENGTH cooperative management and development of international waters in Africa to facilitate sustainable, climate resilient growth.
The main outcomes of the CIWA-MDTF are: . Regional cooperation and integration strengthened . Water resources management strengthened . Water resources development strengthened . Stakeholder engagement and coordination strengthened"
